title: Warkat ñiñ tànn
intro: Ci taarix, ay ndawu Yàlla dañu daan doxantu ci biir nit ñi, ba noppi yenn ci ñi leen gënoon jege mënu ñu woon xàmmee leer gi. Léeb bii dafay nettali ñaari ruuh yu seen jegewaale nekk yonent nekkoon seen natt, te seen erf nekkoon njàngale budul jeex.
clues: Danu dundu ci jamonoy yonent yu mag, waaye sunuy bët tëjuwoon nañu ci dëgg gi ñuy indi.
Sunuy kër fees dell ak feeñu Yàlla, waaye sunuy xol dañu dëgër.
Nu sëyoon ak góor ñuñ tànn ngir artu seen askan.
Bi daan jotee, nu wut nu nu mëna rëcci ci gaal gi, nu daw taw bu tàng bi, ndax danu doon ñaawal àrtu yi.
Dañu nu wax ci Al Quran ni misaal ci ñi gëmul, di wane ni diggante bu jege sax ak yonent du mucc.
Nun nooy soxnay Nuh ak Luut, ñi leen wor ba ñu àtte leen.

trial.label: Lan moo nekkoon seen àtte ?
options: Ñoom dañoo takk ay yonent waaye gëmuñu woon .
Ñu mënu woon am doom, ñuy tuumal yonent yi
Dañu amoon xaalis ba noppi réy seen bopp
Ibliis fiir na ñu ñu bàyyi seen i kër .
Dañu jaamu Naat bu Wurus bi .
trial.answer: Ñoom dañoo takk ay yonent waaye gëmuñu woon .

location.label: Lu seen ëlëg tënk?
options: Mbënd mi ak tawwu xeer yi
location.answer: Mbënd mi ak tawwu xeer yi

outcome.label: Lan moo nekkoon seen muj?
options: Ñu tuub seeni bàkkaar, ñu mucc
Ñu soppi leen nekk goor ak mbaam xuux

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
